comparison.objective: Place an insulating cork pad on glass, then bimanually carry a hot pan onto it; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe sequencing, broad placement, and two-arm heavy-object transport versus narrow-tool alignment, stabilized hammering, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Pan rests on the pad rather than directly on glass, with pad placed before the bimanual carry versus four safe fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: The task tests sequencing and protective support placement, not precision impact fracture. No spec versions or allowable pan/pad overlap and glass-contact thresholds are available.
